counterfactual_missing_items: no history of lichen sclerosis, sexually transmitted infection, pelvic radiation, genitourinary trauma, or family history of genitourinary malignancy
decisive_items: Retrograde urethrography showed an approximately 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra
biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma but demonstrated amyloid protein deposition
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it directly addresses the urethral stenosis found in the retrograde urethrography, while R2, although supported by the amyloid protein deposition, does not directly explain the stenosis

rejected.why: C1 is an append-only completion of R2 and does not provide a distinct diagnosis
